# Github Readme And Profile Writing

Write GitHub READMEs with clear positioning, install steps and visual proof.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Writes and improves GitHub READMEs for projects, skills, organizations, and personal profiles—clear positioning, install and quick start, visual proof, badges, and one next action. Use when creating, auditing, or rewriting a README or profile README.

Example request:

> Use github-readme-and-profile-writing to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill github-readme-and-profile-writing
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/github-readme-and-profile-writing/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/github-readme-and-profile-writing/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
